page.layout: One page of text; a decorative woodcut initial at the start of the body paragraph (left side). No margin notes. Title block at top, then heading, then text paragraph.

main_text.head: Clarissimo ac Doctissimo viro D. ABRAHAMO HEIDANO, S. S. Theologiæ Doctori, ejusdemque in Academia Lugduno-Batava Professori Seniori, ac Primario, nec non verbi divini in ecclesia ejusdem civitatis Præconi difertissimo à multis retro annis, multisque in regionibus buccinante fama, Magno concionatori vocato.
Ob singularem pietatem atque sapientiam venerande senex.
main_text.p: Quanquam in ea tempora incidisse videamur, in quibus regnante morum barbarie sub pallio & amictu Virtutis, nihil minus quam de bonis moribus, probitate, finceritate animi cogitent homines, clanculum iræ, odiò, invidiæ, indeque pullulantibus vitiis dediti; tamen non ita virtus exulat, quin & ejus Proci, Piique inveniantur, & de Virtute crebri sermones habeantur in Eccle-

page.notes: The woodcut initial "Q" is decorative; read as Quanquam. Printed text is partly faint in the upper ornament. Last word "Eccle-" is a line-end hyphenation, continuing on the next page. Several words in the title line are set in italic type and some letters are uncertain (e.g. "Præconi", "difertissimo" read as printed "difertiffimo").
